before: Tags and caret slots existed only for inline controls, and removeContentControl { keepContent: false } on a block control could leave a story with no paragraph, a cell that did not end with one, or a section mark dropped with its paragraph.
after: Block-level controls get tags at the start of their first paragraph and the end of their last, and a key beside one selects or removes the control. A removal that takes a block control's content is refused with block-required or carries-section-mark where deleteBlock would refuse.
reason: Tags and slots are view state and travel to no peer. The removal refusal only rejects ops that would publish a document Word rejects; every op a released participant can send that was valid before stays valid.
